title: スプリングSの後に・バクシン成長

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After facing defeat, Sakura Bakushin O is left stunned. Believing there's a possibility she is not talented in any capacity, she becomes a mess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to encourage her by saying that more speed will guarantee victory. My next suggestion is the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trusting in my words, Sakura Bakushin O is confident she'll grow through her latest race.
